items.title: Source: Alford to sign with Bills on 3-year deal
items.description: Free agent cornerback Dee Alford plans to sign with the Buffalo Bills on a three-year deal worth up to $21 million, a source told ESPN.

items.title: Colts re-sign WR Pierce, trade Pittman to Steelers
items.description: The Indianapolis Colts are re-signing wide receiver Alec Pierce but are trading his running mate Michael Pittman Jr. out of town.

items.title: Sources: Commanders bringing back QB Mariota
items.description: The Washington Commanders are re-signing backup quarterback Marcus Mariota on a one-year, $7 million deal, according to NFL Network.

items.title: Sources: Cowboys reach deal with S Thompson
items.description: The Dallas Cowboys have made another addition to their defense, agreeing to a three-year, $33 million contract with safety Jalen Thompson, sources told ESPN's Todd Archer.

items.title: Falcons release WR Mooney, free $7.4M in cap
items.description: The Falcons have released wide receiver Darnell Mooney, the team announced Monday.

items.title: Source: Seahawks to re-sign cornerback Jobe
items.description: The Seattle Seahawks are re-signing cornerback Josh Jobe to a three-year, $24 million contract, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.

items.title: Bengals signing Seahawks LB Mafe, Chiefs S Cook
items.description: The Cincinnati Bengals are bolstering their defense with former Seahawks LB Boye Mafe and former Chiefs safety Bryan Cook.

items.title: Sources: Raiders give C Linderbaum record deal
items.description: Free agent center Tyler Linderbaum reached agreement Monday on a record deal with the Raiders, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.title: Sources: QB Willis, Fins reach 3-year, $67.5M deal
items.description: Free agent QB Malik Willis, after reviving his career with the Packers, has agreed to a three-year, $67.5 million deal with the Dolphins, sources told ESPN.

items.title: Browns bolster OL, reach deal with G Johnson
items.description: Free agent guard Zion Johnson and the Cleveland Browns reached agreement Monday on a three-year, $49.5 million deal that includes $32.4 million guaranteed, agents Alan Herman and Jared Fox told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.title: Mike Evans' fit in San Fran? 49ers bring leadership to WR room amid renovation
items.description: Evans has agreed to sign a three-year contract with the 49ers, leaving the Tampa Bay Buccaneers after 12 seasons.

items.title: Sources: Tua to sign 1-year deal with Falcons
items.description: Former Miami Dolphins quarterback Tua Tagovailoa plans to sign a one-year deal with the Atlanta Falcons, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.title: Star WR Evans leaving Bucs to sign with 49ers
items.description: Star wide receiver Mike Evans is leaving the Buccaneers to sign a three-year deal with the 49ers, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.title: Source: Super Bowl MVP Walker to join Chiefs
items.description: Super Bowl MVP Kenneth Walker III has agreed to sign with the Kansas City Chiefs, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.title: Busy Titans add WR Robinson, DL Franklin-Myers
items.description: Wide receiver Wan'Dale Robinson reached agreement Monday with the Tennessee Titans, reuniting him with offensive coordinator Brian Daboll, his former coach with the New York Giants.

items.title: Prosecutors to drop charge against Pats' Barmore
items.description: Massachusetts prosecutors said Monday that they will drop a domestic assault and battery charge against New England Patriots defensive lineman Christian Barmore because they do not believe they can prove their case.

items.title: Cops responded to 911 calls before Pearce arrest
items.description: In the weeks before Falcons linebacker James Pearce Jr. allegedly rammed his vehicle into WNBA player Rickea Jackson's car, at least seven 911 calls indicate heightened fears from his unidentified girlfriend that she was being stalked and harassed.

items.title: Packers release OL Jenkins, open up $19.5M
items.description: The Green Bay Packers are moving on from offensive lineman Elgton Jenkins, releasing the left guard/center to free up more than $19.5 million in cap space.

items.title: Commanders land Oweh on 4-year, $100M deal
items.description: Former Chargers defensive end Odafe Oweh, who has 17.5 sacks since 2024, has agreed with the Commanders on a four-year, $100 million deal, his agents told ESPN.
